title: The strict /^-?\d+$/ guard exists specifically to defeat the lenient-parseInt t…
body: The strict /^-?\d+$/ guard exists specifically to defeat the lenient-parseInt trap (Number.parseInt('12abc') === 12), but no unit test drives that case: test/tmux-display-message.test.ts covers the empty-field variant ('12;;80;24') instead. I verified the behavior manually against the real helper (non-integer field -> null, see scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt section 3d) so this is a coverage gap, not a defect. Adding a '12abc;5;80;24' case would pin the guard that the doc comment calls load-bearing.
